definitions.explanation: The first or most basic level of something, especially in education. Refers to the foundational stage before advancing to higher levels.

examples.japanese: {初等|しょとう}{教育|きょういく}は{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{初等|しょとう}{数学|すうがく}から{学|まな}び{直|なお}す。
この{講座|こうざ}は{初等|しょとう}レベルの{内容|ないよう}なので、{初心者|しょしんしゃ}でも{安心|あんしん}して{参加|さんか}できる。
examples.english: This course covers introductory-level content, so even beginners can participate with confidence.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily used as a prefix in compound words. {初等|しょとう}{教育|きょういく} refers to primary/elementary education (grades 1-6 in Japan). Part of a series: {初等|しょとう} (elementary) → {中等|ちゅうとう} (intermediate/secondary) → {高等|こうとう} (higher/advanced).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初等|しょとう}{教育|きょういく} (elementary education)
- {初等|しょとう}{数学|すうがく} (elementary mathematics)
- {初等|しょとう}レベル (introductory level)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中等|ちゅうとう}: intermediate, secondary — the next level up
- {高等|こうとう}: higher, advanced — the highest level
